note: M04 development evidence only. The accessibility gate (tools/verify_a11y.py) runs the suite in the official Playwright image named here by digest, on the Node release named here by version and by the sha256 of its linux-x64 tarball on nodejs.org, whose SHASUMS256.txt was signed by the key named. pnpm is pinned once, by packageManager in package.json, and its binary by the integrity pnpm-lock.yaml records; every npm package is pinned by pnpm-lock.yaml. `make a11y-fetch` downloads these into a cache outside the repository; the gate itself never pulls or downloads and runs the container with networking disabled.
